hero.zh: 空间可以预渲染，信息不能被烘焙进图片。
hero.en: Space may be pre-rendered. Information must not be baked into imagery.

intro.zh: 当用户只需要理解尺度、剖面和材质，稳定媒体比实时场景更合适；所有结论仍由文档承担。
intro.en: When readers only need scale, section, and material, stable media is a better carrier than realtime graphics; the document still carries every conclusion.

title.zh: 用一幅总图建立基础设施尺度。
title.en: Use one master plate to establish infrastructure scale.

body.zh: 重复单元、维护通道和周边能源设施在同一画面中可比较。
body.en: Repeated units, service routes, and surrounding energy systems remain comparable in one frame.

title.zh: 再用剖面解释运营关系。
title.en: Then use sections to explain operations.

body.zh: 局部图回答冷却、检修和材料寿命，不承担导航。
body.en: Detail plates answer cooling, service, and material-life questions without becoming navigation.
